code.text: COAG

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows severe hypoxemia and acidemia (low pH, low O₂ saturation, low pO₂), pancytopenia (low leukocytes, neutrophils, platelets, mild anemia), elevated D-dimer, ferritin, LDH, CRP, and INR, with low total protein. These findings suggest severe systemic inflammation, possible sepsis or multi-organ dysfunction, and a high risk of coagulopathy. Immediate clinical evaluation and intervention are strongly recommended.
